notes.title: Update: Bullet Hit Reactions + Footsteps
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This update improves how combat feels and sounds:

🔸 Bullet Hit Reactions
Enemies now react when hit by handgun fire - adding a sense of impact and responsiveness, especially up close.

🔸 Enemy Footsteps
You’ll now hear a soft, subtle step as enemies approach. It’s not loud, but enough to help you sense their movement and presence.

Thanks for playing and for all the feedback!

--emagnetic

notes.title: New Difficulty System
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I’ve added [b]three difficulty levels[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]Easy[/b] - based on the old Core mode
[*] [b]Normal[/b] - inherits from Hard mode
[*] [b]Hard[/b] - now even harder than before
[/list]
Each difficulty has [b]separate save data[/b], including scores, health, ammo, and mission progress.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] A [b]remaining enemies counter[/b] now appears in the HUD.
[*] [b]Balance improvements[/b] across all difficulties:
[list]
[*] Phantom enemies are removed during early waves
[*] Fireballs appear later and scale up slower on lower difficulties
[*] Fireball speed and quantity scale by difficulty
[*] Slight blackout effect added after a fireball hit
[*] Enemy movement speed ramps up more aggressively on Hard
[/list][/list]
Let me know how each level feels - especially if you survive on Hard!

--emagnetic

notes.title: ⚠️ Enemy Behind Alert - Update #4 is Live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Big thanks to [i]AndersonSmith[/i] on Reddit for highlighting a key issue - no warning when enemies approach from behind.

With a boost from alien tech and your feedback, here’s what’s added:

[h3]⚠️ Enemy Behind Alert[/h3]
The HUD alert triggers when these conditions are met:
[olist]
[*] The player is not moving or moving backward
[*] An enemy is within the backward alert cone (the cone narrows with higher backward speed)
[*] The player is not turning too fast
[/olist]
It’s a small change that adds real situational awareness - especially on tougher waves.
Don’t like it? You can fully customize it in Settings:
[list]
[*] [b]Visual + Beep[/b]
[*] [b]Visual Only[/b] (default)
[*] [b]Beep Only[/b]
[*] [b]Off[/b]
[/list]
Test it out and let me know if it helps. I’m always listening - and updating.

— emagnetic

notes.title: 📢 Story is Coming to Alien Grounds (Starting Update #5)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A lot of you asked for it - and you're right. Alien Grounds needs more meaning behind the chaos.

So here's the deal: I'm starting to build a story into the main game itself, not as a separate mode, but woven into the experience - one piece at a time, starting with Update #5.

Now, my Hollywood team went on strike when I couldn’t afford coffee, so I’ll be writing this myself. Expect short transmissions, map context, weird signals, and a hint that there’s more going on beneath the surface...

What’s the story?
Let’s just say it’s… waking up.

— emagnetic

tags.feature: So here's the deal: I'm starting to build a story into the main game itself, not as a separate mode, but woven into the experience - one piece at a time, starting with Update #5.

notes.title: ☠️ Update #3 - Hard Mode is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

[b]Hard Mode is now live:[/b] switch to it from the [b]Main Menu[/b].

[h3]🎮 Difficulty Modes Overview[/h3]

[b]🧊 Chill Mode[/b] [i](Proposed)[/i]
• Score Bonus: [b]0.1x[/b]
• [b]Revive on defeat[/b] - score and wave position are kept
• Player Damage: [b]1.0x out, 0.1x in[/b]
• Default enemy count and wave size

[b]⚙️ Core Mode[/b] [i](Default)[/i]
• Score Bonus: [b]1.0x[/b]
• [b]Revive on defeat[/b] - score and wave position are kept
• Player Damage: [b]1.0x out, 1.0x in[/b]
• Default enemy count and wave size

[b]💥 Hard Mode[/b] [i](New)[/i]
• Score Bonus: [b]1.5x[/b]
• [b]Restart wave on defeat[/b] - wave score is lost
• Player Damage: [b]0.5x out, 1.5x in[/b]
• More active enemies; increased wave size

[b]🚀 Elite Mode[/b] [i](Proposed)[/i]
• Score Bonus: [b]3.0x[/b]
• [b]Restart game on defeat[/b] - total score and wave progress are lost
• Player Damage: [b]0.3x out, 2.0x in[/b]
• Much more active enemies; maximum wave size

[h3]💡 Mode Switching[/h3]
Switching between modes [b]keeps your score and wave progress[/b].
You can start in [b]Core Mode[/b] and move to [b]Hard Mode[/b] anytime via the [b]Main Menu[/b].

⚠️ Note: In the proposed [b]Elite Mode[/b], being defeated will [b]reset everything[/b] - you'll return to [b]Wave 1 with zero score[/b].

[h3]📈 What’s Next?[/h3]
Once modes are finalized and balance is settled, the next step will be [b]leaderboards[/b].
Have experience with great (or terrible) leaderboard systems?
Let me know what you'd like to see!

— Emagnetic
